DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (Penis and Digit).
The history of non-healing, crusted lesions on the penis and finger in a 62-year-old smoker, combined with negative systemic symptoms and failed prior treatments for syphilis/eczema, is highly suggestive of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
